summary.text: Kevin Alons is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 7 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he runs a software company.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Alons earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics and computer science from the University of Northwestern in St. Paul in 1991 and a master's degree in information technology management from Webster University in 2012.
His career experience includes owning Alons Software, Inc.
He assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
